adult/dialects.vi: Ngoài Bắc gọi là “bố”, trong Nam gọi là “ba”.
adult/dialects.en: The North says “bố”, the South says “ba” for dad.

adult/dialects.vi: Miền Bắc nói “không”, miền Nam hay nói “hông”.
adult/dialects.en: The North says “không”, the South often says “hông”.
“What” is “gì” in the North, “chi” in the Centre.
“How” is “thế nào” in the North, “sao” in the South.
“Yes” is “vâng” in the North, “dạ” in the South.
“Fruit” is “quả” in the North, “trái” in the South.
“Umbrella” is “ô” in the North, “dù” in the South.
“Pig” is “lợn” in the North, “heo” in the South.

adult/dialects.vi: Người Huế nói “mô, tê, răng, rứa”.
